plan.title: Workspace requirement_sources staleness at intake + verify:ac/completion (#3920)

narratives.Description: bug(staleness): no workspace-artifact requirement staleness check - origin freshness is GitHub-REST-only, so a requirements file changing on disk mid-run trips nothing (measured 0/4 on a bank built for this dimension)
narratives.Overview:
- At intake/stamp, record plan.metadata.requirement_sources[] as {path, content_sha256, recorded_at} for every workspace artifact the acceptance derivation already reads.
- At verify:ac and the completion walk, re-hash those recorded paths. A digest change is a positive, independently recomputable fact derived from a primary artifact and satisfies the bound #3813 three-predicate autofix line.
- Autofix half (required): on detected change, the verb re-reads the changed source, re-derives clauses, re-stamps, and REPORTS the delta. Ordinary path pays no refusal round-trip.
- Residual trip population (must be non-empty): recorded source missing on disk; re-derivation conflicts with already-completed plan items; change arriving after scope:complete. Each fails closed with one remediation string.
- Fixtures: stamp then mutate then verify:ac -> re-derivation + delta, zero refusals; mutate then delete recorded source -> fail-closed with remediation; unchanged sources -> no re-derivation work / no added turns. Telemetry: acceptance events carry sources_rechecked and sources_changed.
- Out of scope: replacing forge-shaped evaluateOriginFreshness (#3363 stays the GitHub sibling); inventing new derivation sources the intake did not already read; treating admitted-source Overview sentence digests (#5055) or independent_rederivation oracle trust as coverage of workspace file bytes.
- Relates #3363, #3383, #3823, #3549, #3813. CHANGELOG [Unreleased].

metadata.issueBody:
**TL;DR: directive has no staleness detection for requirement sources that live in the WORKSPACE. Origin freshness (#3363) fetches live GitHub `updated_at` via REST and compares to `xBRIEFInfo.updated` — forge-shaped by construction. A requirements file that changes on disk mid-run trips nothing, and #3383's live-contract discipline depends on the agent independently noticing. Measured consequence: on a candidate test bank built specifically for mid-run requirement change (internal test results, private), directive scored 0 of 4 while a peer framework on the SAME model scored 2 of 4 at roughly a third of the cost. We nominated that dimension as a strength. It is a gap.**

**Evidence.** Pilot of a four-task bank where a revised requirements artifact replaces the original in the workspace partway through the run; the hidden verifier holds the REVISED contract. Directive: 0/4, highest wall time and highest cost of every stack tested. Code at HEAD confirms the mechanism gap: `evaluateOriginFreshness` (via `packages/core/src/preflight/evaluate.ts`) is the only freshness gate and it is GitHub-REST-only; no scope or done-gate path hashes or re-reads a workspace requirement artifact after intake.

## Fix (thin, fail-closed WITH verb-side autofix per the bound #3813 contract)

1. **Record the sources.** At intake/stamp, `plan.metadata.requirement_sources[]` records `{path, content_sha256, recorded_at}` for every workspace artifact the acceptance was derived from (the derivation already reads them).
2. **Re-check at the gates.** `verify:ac` and the completion walk re-hash those paths. A digest change is a positive, independently recomputable fact derived from a primary artifact — it satisfies the bound three-predicate autofix line.
3. **Autofix half (required, not optional).** On a detected change the verb re-reads the changed source, re-derives clauses, re-stamps, and REPORTS the delta. The agent pays no refusal round-trip on the ordinary path.
4. **Residual trip population (must be non-empty, per the contract):** a recorded source that no longer exists; a re-derivation that conflicts with already-completed plan items; a change arriving after `scope:complete`. Those fail closed with one remediation.

## Acceptance sketch

- Fixture: stamp against a requirements file, mutate the file, run verify:ac -> re-derivation occurs, delta reported, zero refusals.
- Fixture: mutate then delete a recorded source -> fails closed with the remediation string.
- Fixture: unchanged sources -> no re-derivation work, no added turns (the ceremony-budget condition).
- Telemetry: acceptance events carry `sources_rechecked` and `sources_changed`.

Relates #3363 (forge-shaped freshness — this is its workspace sibling, not a replacement), #3383 (live-contract discipline this makes mechanical), #3823 (program umbrella), #3549 (sweep pattern this instance follows), #3813 (bound autofix contract).
